# 01 — System Overview

## What is The Craic Gazette?

The Craic Gazette is an AI-powered Irish newspaper that demonstrates LangChain and
LangGraph by doing something genuinely useful: generating a fresh, funny daily edition.

**The twist:** every article is generated by THREE different AI models simultaneously —
Claude, Gemini, and a local LLM — using the **exact same prompt**. The website lets
you switch between editions and compare how each model interpreted it.

This makes the site both a working news generator and a live LLM comparison tool.

---

## Architecture at a Glance

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  GitHub Actions — Daily Cron (06:00 UTC)                        │
│  Runs on: self-hosted runner (your home machine)                │
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  LangGraph Pipeline  (content_pipeline/)                  │   │
│  │                                                            │   │
│  │  [research] → [generate] → [compile] → [publish]          │   │
│  │                                                            │   │
│  │  research: ReAct agent with news + weather tools           │   │
│  │  generate: RunnableParallel × 3 providers                  │   │
│  │    ├── Claude  (Anthropic API)                             │   │
│  │    ├── Gemini  (Google AI)                                 │   │
│  │    └── Local   (LM Studio, localhost:1234)                 │   │
│  │  compile: Assemble JSON                                    │   │
│  │  publish: boto3 → S3                                       │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
             │
             ▼
  S3 bucket / CloudFront CDN
  content/YYYY/MM/DD/paper_content.json
             │
             ▼
  craicgpt.ie (static HTML/JS)
  Browser fetches JSON, renders with model comparator UI
```

## Quick Start (local development)

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.11+
- LM Studio installed and running with a model loaded
- Anthropic API key (https://console.anthropic.com)
- Google AI API key (https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)
- AWS credentials with S3 put permissions

### Setup

```bash
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/your-username/craicgpt.ie
cd craicgpt.ie
pip install -r content_pipeline/requirements.txt

# Create .env file (never commit this)
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your API keys

# Test with a dry run (no S3 upload)
python content_pipeline/main.py --dry-run

# See the pipeline structure
python content_pipeline/main.py --show-graph

# Generate for a specific date
python content_pipeline/main.py 2026-03-03
```

### Environment Variables

| Variable                    | Description                              | Example                    |
|-----------------------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`         | Claude API key                           | `sk-ant-...`               |
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY`            | Gemini API key                           | `AIza...`                  |
| `LM_STUDIO_BASE_URL`        | LM Studio server URL                     | `http://localhost:1234/v1` |
| `LM_STUDIO_MODEL`           | Model identifier in LM Studio            | `local-model`              |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`         | AWS access key                           | `AKIA...`                  |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`     | AWS secret key                           | `...`                      |
| `S3_BUCKET`                 | Target S3 bucket name                    | `craicgpt-ie-production`   |
| `DRY_RUN`                   | Skip S3 upload (true/false)              | `true`                     |
| `SKIP_LOCAL_LLM`            | Skip LM Studio (true/false)              | `false`                    |
| `WEATHER_LOCATION`          | City for weather lookup                  | `Dublin`                   |
